# FrontierTech.news

> Emerging technology journalism for builders and early adopters. FrontierTech.news covers AI, blockchain, energy, biotech, space, and climate tech — explaining what's actually changing and why it matters, without hype or overclaiming.

FrontierTech.news is part of an independent media network. Coverage is reported and edited independently; where a business relationship exists with a company mentioned in an article, it is disclosed in that article, and forward-looking claims about unreleased capabilities are stated as forward-looking, never as fact. Articles are bylined to the reporting desk (the FrontierTech Desk, or the FrontierTech Science & Health Desk for biotech/health-adjacent subjects) rather than an anonymous brand byline.

What happened, and why it matters.

- [FDA Approves Fayuvi, the First Treatment for Sanfilippo Syndrome Type A](https://frontiertech.news/fda-approves-fayuvi-sanfilippo-syndrome-type-a-gene-therapy): The FDA approved Ultragenyx's Fayuvi, a one-time AAV9 gene therapy and the first treatment for Sanfilippo syndrome type A (MPS IIIA).

- [Enhanced Geothermal Just Achieved First Power in Utah](https://frontiertech.news/enhanced-geothermal-fervo-2026): Fervo Energy's Cape Station in Utah became the first utility-scale enhanced geothermal project to reach first power, using drilling borrowed from oil and gas.
- [The Battery That Runs on Rust Just Landed Its Biggest Deal Yet](https://frontiertech.news/iron-air-battery-storage-2026): Form Energy's iron-air battery, built for storage lithium can't cheaply cover, landed a 300-megawatt, 30-gigawatt-hour deal backing a Google data center.
